scientific_integrity: All stated real-weight cases follow from explicit harmonic comparisons, not numerical extrapolation. Finite minimality uses exhaustive exact-integer/rational enumeration and a distinct labeled-candidate implementation. No independent external audit or formal certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Analytic phase theorem is for three voter types with first two multiplicities equal, three two-member candidate classes, and a four-seat committee. Minimum 17 applies only to this triangle structure, though it allows three different positive integer multiplicities. The general failure of seq-PAV to optimize PAV is previously known; only this exact robust phase/cutoff is considered. Independently checked publication priority is not guaranteed.
title: A sharp greedy-failure window for harmonic approval committees on a three-bloc triangle
